svg.title: Figure 6-1. The AI safety requirements and how far they have got (WP-C-11 §6)
svg.desc: 30 AI safety requirements of WP-C-11 §6 by group. 6.1 Performance: AIR-01 (not evaluated), AIR-02 (not evaluated), AIR-03 (not evaluated), AIR-04 (not evaluated), AIR-05 (not evaluated), AIR-06 (not evaluated), AIR-07 (not evaluated), AIR-08 (not evaluated). 6.2 Robustness: AIR-09 (not evaluated), AIR-10 (not evaluated), AIR-11 (not evaluated), AIR-12 (not met). 6.3 Uncertainty estimation: AIR-13 (not evaluated), AIR-14 (not met), AIR-15 (not met). 6.4 Runtime monitoring: AIR-16 (partly), AIR-17 (partly), AIR-18 (not met). 6.5 Integrity and provenance: AIR-19 (not met), AIR-20 (not met), AIR-21 (not met), AIR-22 (not met). 6.6 Version control: AIR-23 (not met), AIR-24 (partly). 6.7 Fallback behaviour and architecture: AIR-25 (not met), AIR-26 (partly), AIR-27 (partly), AIR-28 (partly), AIR-29 (partly), AIR-30 (partly).
svg.text: Figure 6-1 · The AI safety requirements and how far they have got
The 30 AI safety requirements of §6 in their seven groups, each with the component it applies to and its status at the baseline
In nominal ODD conditions, while lateral control is
active and no lane change is requested, the vehicle's
lateral offset from the lane centre shall stay within
±0.5 m throughout at least 99 % of 60 s nominal…
The rate of unrequested lane departures (a front
wheel crossing a lane marking with no desire active
and no driver steering input) shall not exceed the
A lead vehicle in the ego lane within 80 m shall be
becoming unoccluded, with distance error ≤ max(2 m,
A stationary vehicle in the ego lane shall be reported
as a lead at a distance not less than v·t_r +
v²/(2·a_lim), with t_r = 1.0 s and a_lim = 3.0 m/s², for
all speeds in the ODD (e.g., ≈ 180 m at 30 m/s, ≈ 186…
The rate of model-induced decelerations stronger than
2.0 m/s² with no relevant object present (phantom
braking) shall not exceed VT-04 of WP-V-02
In a closing-lead scenario requiring more than 5 m/s²
to avoid collision, hardBrakePredicted shall become
true at a time-to-collision of at least 2.0 s
The DM chain shall classify a driver whose gaze is off
the road for more than 2 s as distracted within 1.0 s
with recall ≥ 95 % per DM stratum (day, night, glasses,
sunglasses). With the 5 s vision-policy timer this gives…
The DM chain shall detect eyes closed > 1 s and
handheld phone use with recall ≥ 90 % and a
false-distraction rate ≤ 1 per hour of attentive driving.
AIR-01…AIR-08 shall be met in each input-space
stratum of §3 for which a claim is made, not only in
aggregate; a stratum that fails is removed from the
Under perturbations inside the input space (calibration
error up to the INS-25 tolerance, exposure ±1 EV,
sensor noise, JPEG/HEVC artefacts, partial lens
occlusion ≤ 10 %), the AI-1 action shall change by…
Frame-to-frame change of desiredCurvature while the
scene is steady shall not exceed the curvature-rate
implied by 5 m/s³ lateral jerk at the current speed;
lead existence (prob crossing 0.5) shall not toggle…
After any (re)initialisation of recurrent state, model
outputs shall not be used for actuation until at least 2
s of consecutive frames have been processed
The standard deviations published for plan, lead and
lane lines shall be calibrated on LionDriver evaluation
data: the observed error shall lie within ±2σ for 90–98
% of samples per stratum, and mean error shall…
WP-M-10) shall flag low-confidence or OOD states
from model σ, lane-line probabilities and action–plan
driverStateV2.valid shall be false when the cabin
image or model uncertainty indicates that the driver
Every AI-1 and AI-3 output tensor shall be checked
for non-finite values and for range plausibility before
use; a failed check shall make the published message
invalid and cause a driver take-over request, never a…
Model inference shall complete within 50 ms (TBC
from WP-S-04) per frame; an output older than 100 ms
shall not be used for actuation, and a sustained
overrun shall raise a take-over request within the…
with the curvature implied by the published plan and
flag divergence above a threshold set from evaluation
Before deserialization, each model and warp artefact
shall be verified against a SHA-256 value from the
signed release manifest; on mismatch the artefact
shall not be loaded and engagement shall be…
No deserialization mechanism capable of executing
code (Python pickle) shall be applied to data that has
For each released model, the provenance record shall
contain: source artefact LFS oid and size, upstream
commit that introduced it, tinygrad commit and compile
flags used, compiled artefact hash, compile host, and…
The compiled device artefact shall reproduce the
outputs of a reference execution of the source ONNX
(independent runtime) on a fixed input set within a
Every drive log shall identify the exact model
artefacts in use (hash or release-manifest ID), so
that field data can be attributed to a model version
Any change to a model artefact, the tinygrad pin, or
the files listed in WP-M-10 §9 shall be released only
after the AIR verification set has been re-run on the
new configuration (D-05, adopted as written by the…
On failure of the driving model while engaged
system shall stop using model outputs for actuation,
warn the driver and hand back control within the…
Engagement shall not be permitted until the driving
model has published valid outputs for at least 2 s
If the DM model output is unavailable or invalid for
longer than 2 s while engaged, the system shall
escalate to a take-over alert and disengage if the
AI outputs shall reach the actuators only through
controlsd/card and the panda safety envelope; no
AI-derived signal shall alter envelope limits or the
shall not be a candidate in longitudinal arbitration
unless WP-C-07 admits Experimental Mode to the ODD
AI-2 (Chestnut) shall not be present or loadable in
the reference configuration until AIR-12, AIR-21,
AIR-22 and AIR-25 are met for it
None is met yet. Not evaluated: it needs LionDriver evaluation data, which does not exist yet.
Values marked TBC in §6 are left out of the tiles; they are confirmed through WP-V-02 (OI-2). Components: AI-1 driving model, AI-2 big driving model (excluded), AI-3 driver monitoring model.

g.text: Terms: AI artificial intelligence · AI-nn AI component (WP-C-11 §2.1): AI-1 driving model, AI-2 big driving model (excluded), AI-3 driver monitoring model · AIR-nn AI safety requirement (WP-C-11 §6) · D-nn design

decision of the earlier decision list (D-01…D-12; D-08 is the Experimental Mode decision) · DM driver monitoring · EV exposure value: one EV halves or doubles the light · HEVC a compressed video format (H.265) · ID

identifier · INS-nn installation check (WP-O-01) · JPEG a compressed image format · LFS Git Large File Storage (where the model files live) · ODD operational design domain: where the system is meant to work · OI-nn

open item of the document it appears in · ONNX Open Neural Network Exchange, the model file format · OOD out of distribution: unlike the data the model learned from · RM-nn runtime monitor of the AI safety plan

(WP-M-10) · SHA-256 a cryptographic hash used to identify a file exactly · TBC to be confirmed · VT-nn validation target (WP-V-02) · WP-nn work product, e.g. WP-C-04; the letter is its area (M management, C concept,
S system, H hardware, W software, V validation, P processes, A analyses, O operation, K safety case)
